# Connect an agent to the Katalon True Platform MCP server

Katalon True Platform (formerly TestOps) runs one MCP server for every workspace: `https://platform.katalon.io/mcp`. Sign-in opens in your browser, then you pick a workspace. There is no subdomain to look up. Never paste passwords, tokens, cookies, JWTs, or callback URLs into chat.

Enterprises on a dedicated Katalon domain use `https://<your.sub.domain>.katalon.io/mcp` in place of the endpoint above.

The server name in every snippet is `katalon-prod-mcp`. The skills in this repo name tools by bare name, for example `list_projects`. Some clients add a prefix. Claude Code shows `mcp__<server>__<tool>`, and `mcp__plugin_katalon-true-platform_katalon-prod-mcp__<tool>` when the server comes from the plugin.

Clients that read a skills folder find the skills without more files. `.agents/skills/` serves Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Amp, Zed, Junie, Factory, Augment, Roo, and Windsurf or Devin Desktop. Kiro reads `.kiro/skills/` and Cline reads `.cline/skills/`.

## Snippets

### Claude Code

File: `.mcp.json` in the project, or `~/.claude.json`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Or run `claude mcp add --transport http katalon-prod-mcp https://platform.katalon.io/mcp`. Run `/mcp` in a session to sign in. Type `http` is the documented value. An entry with `url` and no `type` is read as stdio and skipped.

### Codex

File: `~/.codex/config.toml`, or `.codex/config.toml` in a trusted project.

```toml
[mcp_servers.katalon-prod-mcp]
url = "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
auth = "oauth"
```

Or run `codex mcp add katalon-prod-mcp --url https://platform.katalon.io/mcp`. Then run `codex mcp login katalon-prod-mcp`. OAuth is the default, so set no token. Codex reads the project file only when you trust the project.

### Cursor

File: `.cursor/mcp.json` in the project, or `~/.cursor/mcp.json`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor opens the sign-in page on first use.

### VS Code (GitHub Copilot)

File: `.vscode/mcp.json` in the workspace.

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Start the server from the editor. VS Code opens the sign-in page. The top key is `servers` here and `mcpServers` in the other JSON files. Do not copy between them unchecked.

### GitHub Copilot CLI

File: `.github/mcp.json` or `.mcp.json` in the project, or `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Or register the server with `/mcp add` (type `http`). The Copilot docs show bearer headers and do not describe OAuth for remote servers. Test sign-in before you rely on it. The project folder must be trusted.

### Kiro

File: `.kiro/settings/mcp.json` in the workspace, or `~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp",
      "disabled": false,
      "autoApprove": []
    }
  }
}
```

Kiro runs the browser sign-in itself. In the CLI, run `/mcp auth`. Kiro reads remote servers natively. The `mcp-remote` wrapper is not needed.

### Windsurf and Devin Desktop

File: `~/.config/devin/mcp_config.json`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "serverUrl": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

The client opens the sign-in page on first use. This client caps the total tool count across all servers at 100.

### Cline

File: `cline_mcp_settings.json` (user level).

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "streamableHttp",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Use the authorize option in the MCP settings screen. The value is `streamableHttp`. Without `type`, Cline assumes the old `sse` transport.

### Continue

File: `.continue/mcpServers/katalon.yaml` in the project.

```yaml
name: katalon-prod-mcp
version: 0.0.1
schema: v1
mcpServers:
  - name: katalon-prod-mcp
    type: streamable-http
    url: https://platform.katalon.io/mcp
```

Use agent mode. The Continue page documents no OAuth. If sign-in fails, use the fallback below.

### Gemini CLI

File: `settings.json` (project `.gemini/settings.json` or user level).

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "httpUrl": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Or run `gemini mcp add --transport http katalon-prod-mcp https://platform.katalon.io/mcp`. The repo root also carries `gemini-extension.json` for `gemini extensions install`. `httpUrl` means Streamable HTTP. The key `url` means SSE.

### OpenCode

File: `opencode.json` in the project.

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Run `opencode mcp auth katalon-prod-mcp` to sign in. OpenCode waits 5 seconds for the tool list by default. Raise `timeout` if the first load fails.

### Amp

File: `.amp/settings.json` or `~/.config/amp/settings.json`.

```json
{
  "amp.mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Amp starts OAuth on first use. Run `amp mcp approve` for a workspace server.

### Zed

File: Zed `settings.json`.

```json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
```

Zed prompts for sign-in when no `Authorization` header is set.

### Agent Plugins clients

File: `mcp.json` at the plugin root.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json",
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "type": "streamable-http",
      "url": "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

The client reads the file when it installs the plugin. The schema accepts `stdio`, `streamable-http`, and `sse`. It does not accept `http`.

## Clients without remote MCP support

Use the `mcp-remote` wrapper against the same endpoint. It starts a local process and handles sign-in for the client.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "katalon-prod-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote@0.14.3",
        "https://platform.katalon.io/mcp",
        "--transport",
        "http-first"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Why the shapes differ

Each client picks its own transport value. Claude Code and Copilot use `http`. The Agent Plugins schema and Continue use `streamable-http`. Cline uses `streamableHttp`. OpenCode uses `remote`. Cursor, Kiro, Amp, and Zed take only a `url`. One file cannot serve all clients, so this table is the source for every shipped MCP file.
